author: Honours
body:
Well it's not like anyone likes or knows who I am but I am leaving this server now before it's too late. 

These past few days have shown that avicus isn't really heading towards good days especially since not much is being done clearly. I do wish the server the very best and hopefully just maybe.... it'll come through and be "good" again but my honest opinion is that it won't. 

So for the staff team I hope you all really shape up and do whatever it takes to help this server it really needs every little inch it can get lmao. 


#ChillCabin
